correctness.rationale: I read the entire four-vertex RESULT.md and the exact verify_integral_lattice.py source. The directed-path face conditions leave exactly 8 vertices, 16 edges, 8 triangles. The one-skeleton has integral cycle group Z9, and the eight oriented triangle relations form an 8x9 matrix of rank six. The explicit six unit Smith factors show the boundary sublattice is primitive, giving H1=Z3 without torsion and H^1 as the full integral 3-dimensional cocycle kernel. The integral basis N has coefficient recovery from rows 3,5,8; action matrices are built from signed oriented arrow images and fundamental cycles. The source text displays the forward pullback matrices R*,S* and the ordinary left action (R*)^-1,S*. I explicitly checked the stated unimodular RESULT.md change of basis Q transforms these inverse/forward matrices to the coordinate-permutation A3 matrices. The separate script uses another unimodular Q for the same D4 representation in the alternative generator convention; this is not an assertion that these different Q matrices are equal. The rotation -1 sublattice and quarter-turn sublattice are generated by three explicit primitive vectors with determinant 2, proving the saturated direct sum has index 2 and cannot split integrally. This is an exact finite lattice statement, not a characteristic-zero character inference.
